source.sourceRule: Only the locked HY-EXP-0024 Development source manifest and its deterministic frozen candidate/OOF path were used; no Final OOS path was opened.

labeledCandidates.description: All mechanically labeled candidates before OOF Net Edge filtering

oofPredictions.description: Edge-available purged OOF candidates before Net Edge and Portfolio Risk filtering

costDefinitions.grossReturn: directional realized price return before costs and funding
costDefinitions.net18: gross price return + realized funding PnL - 18 bps
costDefinitions.net27: gross price return + realized funding PnL - 27 bps

bucketDefinitions.distinctCalendarMonths: distinct signalTime UTC months represented in the bucket
bucketDefinitions.positiveMonthCoverage: observed exit months whose aggregate net18Bps is positive divided by observed exit months
bucketDefinitions.predictedEdgeDecile: OOF rows ranked ascending by expectedPriceEdgeBps, stable id tie-break, decile 1..10
bucketDefinitions.realizedGrossReturnDecile: rows ranked ascending by grossPriceReturnBps, stable id tie-break, decile 1..10
bucketDefinitions.featureQuartiles: OOF-only empirical q25/q50/q75 cutpoints, calculated mechanically without model fitting or threshold search
